action.description: one of pause, resume, step, hold, release or status

ms.description: hold: how long the hold may stand before expiring, in milliseconds; default 1000, maximum 10000

steps.description: how many ticks step advances; default 1, maximum 600

fromLayer.description: lowest layer to include; omit for no lower bound

kinds.description: keep only these kinds: sprite, text, triangles

path.description: absolute path ending in .json; omit to get the JSON inline

toLayer.description: highest layer to include; omit for no upper bound

vertices.description: record indices of triangle ops whose vertices to return in full

amount.description: how many stills to take; default 1, maximum 60

path.description: absolute path ending in .png; put %04d in it for a burst

pass.description: keep only passes with exactly this label; omit for every pass

path.description: absolute path ending in .json; omit to get the JSON inline

actions.description: the steps to apply, in order

do.description: one of key_down, key_up, move, move_by, scroll, text or delay

dx.description: move_by or scroll: delta along x

dy.description: move_by or scroll: delta along y

key.description: A key name such as w, escape or mouse_left. #<number> also works and is how an unnamed key is reported back, but the number is cog's own key code and is not ASCII or a browser keyCode — #13 is the letter M, and Enter is enter (#84). Use names.

ms.description: delay: milliseconds to wait before the next steps

x.description: move: pointer x in window units

y.description: move: pointer y in window units

down.description: every key and mouse button currently held

pointer.description: the pointer position in window units

down.description: every key and mouse button currently held

pointer.description: the pointer position in window units

path.description: absolute path of a .json file to write the description to instead of returning it inline; parent directories are created and an existing file is overwritten

maxDepth.description: how many levels below the reported root to keep; 0 is that element alone

path.description: absolute path ending in .json; omit to get the JSON inline

subtree.description: index of the element to report, with its descendants; omit for the whole tree
